meta.name: Jeffrey Epstein: Filthy Rich
meta.description: Jeffrey Epstein: Filthy Richis a miniseries about convicted sex-offender Jeffrey Epstein based on the 2016 book of the same name by James Patterson, and co-written by John Connolly and Tim Malloy. The four-part documentary features interviews with several survivors including Virginia Giuffre and Maria Farmer, along with former staff members and former police chief Michael Reiter, a key individual from the first criminal case against Epstein. The series provides insight into the survivors of Jeffrey Epstein, and how he used his wealth and power to commit his crimes.
